title: Geofencing follows the alarm system automatically
body_md: When the connected alarm system is armed, geofencing is automatically activated and does not need to be switched on separately. When the alarm system is disarmed, geofencing is automatically deactivated.
source_region: Section 5.2, red note box at the foot of the page
prev_context: Before this stand the switching paths of geofencing.
next_context: Section 5.3 begins on the next page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 21: equivalent in substance in both directions. Neither version says what applies when the two paths contradict each other.
